porter_force_return.m: Place it back where you found it. Then you may leave.
r: What if I pay you to forget you saw it?
Fine, I will put it back.

porter_headgear_inventory_20.m: Yes. That is where it remains.

porter_headgear_inventory_dc_10.m: Wait! My friend Tocsin over hear would like to make sure that you are not trying to sneak one past us.

porter_no_permission_10.m: And where do you think you are headed, mortal?
r: [while pointing straight ahead] Through that door.

porter_no_permission_20.m: I was not notified. I'm afraid that you will not be allowed to proceed.
r: Oh, sorry about that. I will be on my way then.
[lie] Oh, but I do have permission. One of the masters gave me permission.
How about some gold? Let's say one-thousand pieces?

porter_no_permission_gold_10.m: Sure, if you want to give away your gold, I'll take it.
r: Here, take the thousand coins and move away.

porter_no_permission_gold_20.m: The porter takes the coins and drops them into a bag behind Tocsin.

porter_no_permission_gold_30.m: Thanks a lot! Now leave and don't come back until you are proven to be allowed entry.

porter_no_permission_gold_40.m: I never said I could be bought. Go now!

porter_no_permission_lie_10.m: Oh, which one would that be?

porter_no_permission_lie_20.m: Leave now before Tocsin over here has an early dinner.
r: Calm down! I was just kidding.

porter_permission_10.m: You may proceed, but only for what you were granted allowance for.

porter_player_took_crown_10.m: You moved restricted material and didn't put it back where you found it. Now go do so!

porter_wearing_headgear_10.m: You should be so brazen as to walk out here wearing that. Remove it.

porter_wearing_headgear_20.m: That crown does not leave that room. Not worn. Not carried.
r: I am just looking at it.

porter_wearing_headgear_30.m: Looking was permitted. Possession was not.

about_a_girl.10: Two Elytharan slave ghosts spoke quietly of another who has not joined them at the table. They said she still hides east of them, afraid the Shades might return.
about_a_girl.20: The ghosts said the girl believed she could protect herself with a folded copper talisman she made long ago, but she lost it before she could hide it away from the evil of Undertell.
about_a_girl.30: They remembered that such objects were sometimes taken during inspections, gathered with other personal effects and carried upward to the Masters.
about_a_girl.40: I was told that one of the Masters may still possess the folded copper talisman, kept not for protection, but for understanding.
about_a_girl.50: A Master acknowledged the talisman when I asked about it. He spoke of fear made solid, and said such fear was useful to those who taught the Shadow obedience rather than faith. It can be found in the "lower records", whatever that means.
about_a_girl.60: In the Undertell archival room, I found the folded coin talisman.
about_a_girl.70: I found the terrified girl hiding behind a collapsed rock wall. She would not approach me, nor leave her hiding place.
about_a_girl.80: I tossed the folded copper talisman to her. Only then did she step forward, no longer clinging to the corner she had claimed as safety.
about_a_girl.90: The girl rejoined the others at the table. The Elytharan ghosts spoke her name softly, as if afraid to lose her again.
